caption: The drawing depicts a single jug positioned centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background with a thin, rectangular border framing the image. The jug is rendered in shades of dark brown with black highlights, emphasizing its texture and form. Its body is bulbous with a narrow neck, a wide, flaring spout, and an ornate, looping handle that curves from the top of the neck to the upper body of the jug. The surface of the jug is decorated with various patterns: diagonal ridges on the neck and upper portion, a densely textured midsection, and geometric diamond motifs with circular elements around the lower half. The shading and highlights suggest a glazed, reflective surface. The drawing is composed with the jug as the focal point, isolated against the plain background.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
